searchText: There is bench you can run `EVM2_BENCH_REVM=1 cargo bench -p evm2-cli --bench evm` cool, thanks! nice work, evm2 is definitely an improvement. You guys have a lot of benchmarks but I ran snailtracer only for a quick comparison. **zevm** 21.92 ms, **evm2** 34.57 ms , **revm** 49.76 ms I see there are multiple dispatch styles. Does the command above run the best version, or is there a better one?
